findings.comment: Plan notes reference 'Commercial and Multi-Family Recycling Ordinance' which is outdated. Update all instances to 'Universal Recycling Ordinance' per current City of Austin ordinance.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet, Austin Fire Department requirements table, Block 5
findings.comment: Fire Design Codes table cites '2021 International Fire Code Edition' as the applicable standard. Update to the currently adopted 2024 IFC per Ordinance 20250410-039, effective July 10, 2025.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet, Block 12; General Notes sheet, Block 12; Site Plan sheet, Block 5
findings.comment: Plan notes contain bracketed instructional/template text '(or identify the service provider if other than the City of Austin)' that has not been replaced or removed. City of Austin Water and Wastewater Utility is the service provider; remove bracketed placeholder text and finalize service provider designation.

applicableAreas: Cover sheet, Integrated Pest Management Plan placeholder, Block 12
findings.comment: Plan notes contain blank placeholder text for Integrated Pest Management Plan document number: 'document No.____________'. Once any required legal documents are recorded, replace placeholder with actual recorded document number.

applicableAreas: Site Plan sheet, Site Plan Release Notes, Block 5, Note (g)
findings.comment: Site Plan Release Notes reference 'residential condominium project' and condominium-specific requirements (Chapter 81 and 82 of Property Code compliance), but the project is a multi-family townhomes development, not a condominium structure. Remove condominium-specific language and replace with appropriate multi-family project requirements, or clarify the project's legal structure.

applicableAreas: Fire Protection Plan sheet, Fire Zone Notes, Block 5, Item 1
findings.comment: Fire Zone Notes, Item 1 references placement of signage 'on front of lockers and along boat slip retaining walls as necessary or required' — these features are not applicable to this townhomes project and reflect template boilerplate language. Remove inapplicable feature references and retain only applicable fire zone signage requirements.

applicableAreas: General Notes sheet, Site Plan Release Notes, Block 12
findings.comment: Site Plan Release Notes on General Notes sheet show notes numbered 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10 with note number 7 missing. Either note 7 was intentionally removed during consolidation or a note is incorrectly numbered. Verify note sequence and correct numbering to ensure proper organization and prevent confusion.
